verdict.rationale: As a DGX system with its own management stack (BMC, health monitoring, Redfish/SNMP), event-driven automation is a fair question for this product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only shows built-in health monitoring with system alerts and standard management protocols. It does not document any capability for users to define rules that automatically trigger actions on events, and alerts alone are an adjacent feature that earns no credit.
